title: Positive-part integral as an upper-tail integral
statement:
Let $
u$ be a measure on $\mathbb R$ and let $t\in\mathbb R$. If the function $z\mapsto(z-t)^+$ is integrable with respect to $
u$, then
\[\int_{\mathbb R}(z-t)^+\,d
u(z)=\int_0^\infty 
u_{\mathrm{real}} igl((t+u,\infty) igr)\,du.\]
